title: Characters
concept: Char holds a single character, using single quotes like 'A' or '7'.
why: Sometimes you need one character, not a whole string. Char is lighter and more precise.
tips: A Char is always exactly one character
common_mistakes: Using double quotes for a Char: `"A"` is a Str, not a Char
Putting multiple characters in a Char: `'AB'` doesn't work
Forgetting the quotes entirely: `let c: Char = A;` is an error
